comparison_plan: Stata ATT(g,t) and analytical SE for four control-group x base-period specifications compared against R at 1e-10, plus the upstream invariance that all four agree and the post cell recovers the true effect.
scope_note: Two-group design: one treated cohort plus never-treated, four periods, n=5000, seed 20241017. Never-treated and not-yet-treated control sets coincide, so all four specifications must agree.
